description.narrative: Impact: Vulnerable people are more resilient to crises in the face of climate change and environmental degradation, enabling sustainable inclusive economic growth. Long term outcome: Enhanced policies, investments and practices for vulnerable communities to become resilient in the face of disaster risks. Impact group: people vulnerable to crisis in the face of climate change and environmental degradation. By: lobby and advocacy, and strengthening local civil society in lobby and advocacy
